title: Honey Dewy Honey Infused Hair & Body Mist

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Mist & Hair Mist > Women > Fragrance

descriptionHtml:
✓ Hydrating✓ All Hair Textures✓ Alcohol Free✓ All Hair Types✓ Clean at Sephora
Fragrance Family: Fresh

Scent Type: Fresh Solar

Key Notes: Honey Nectar, Vanilla Musk, White Musk

Fragrance Description: A luminous blend of honey nectar, vanilla milk, and white musk. Warm and joyful, it takes you to golden summer days with sunshine on your skin.

About the Fragrance: An alcohol-free fragrance mist enriched with Mirsalehi Honey Water, hyaluronic acid, and peptides to scent and hydrate hair and skin for a honey glow from head to toe.

Clean at Sephora
Clean at Sephora is our commitment to offering effective products without certain ingredients, such as parabens, sulfates, phthalates, and mineral oils. Learn more
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Shake well and mist all over hair and body for a honey glow from head to toe.
Ingredients+
Aqua (Water, Eau), Isopentyldiol, Parfum (Fragrance), C12-13 Alketh-9, Xylitylglucoside, Mel (Honey, Miel)*, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sh-Polypeptide-123, Saccharomyces Ferment Lysate Filtrate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Pelvetia Canaliculata Extract, Anhydroxylitol, Maltitol, Xylitol, Benzyl Glycol, Benzotriazolyl Dodecyl P-Cresol, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Raspberry Ketone, Benzyl Alcohol, Acetyl Cedrene**, Benzyl Benzoate**, Benzyl Cinnamate**, Coumarin**, Linalool**, Myroxylon Pereirae Oil/Extract**, Rose Ketones**, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes**, Vanillin**.
